ValidationRule.description: Prevent Sales from changing discount entered by DD/COE on specific Products.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( ISCHANGED( SBQQ__Discount__c ), ISCHANGED( SBQQ__AdditionalDiscountAmount__c )), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules), NOT( $User.ProfileId = '00e60000001FUqR'), SBQQ__Product__r.SBQQ__NonDiscountable__c = True
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to change discount. Please contact Deal Desk for assistance.
